messages:
maria-pm: Quick intake—ACME contacted AE asking for better console observability: per-team cost breakdown, per-route latency heatmap, and a link from dashboard -> trace for slow requests. They want this to evaluate model mix costs for an upcoming renewal.

jamal-support: +1. Saw similar ask from Zephyr and Datawise last month. At least 3 enterprise customers asking for more granular billing views.

elaine-sales: This is getting raised in contract renewals. ACME said it would be a deal driver if we can show per-product-line cost and allow CSV export for their internal FinOps team.

maria-pm: MVP proposal: console card showing per-model and per-route cost (daily aggregation), CSV export, and an API endpoint for cost reports. Stretch: latency heatmap and trace links. Question for eng: estimates?

dan-eng: Need to know what metrics we already emit. If we have token_count, model_name, route, latency_ms, and team_id at request time, we can aggregate downstream. Main work: UI + secure CSV export + retention config. Rough dev effort: 3 sprints for MVP (1 engineer + 1 frontend).

olivia-telemetry: We currently log these fields to telemetry pipeline: model_name, route, token_count, latency_ms, region, request_id, org_id. Retention is 90d by default. We can add a daily rollup job to produce per-team/day cost buckets. Cost calc needs model unit-cost mapping (we already store model SKU in meta).

jamal-support: Sample customer asks: "we need per-team, per-route, and ability to see 30/60/90 day cost trends. must be exportable, and admins only."

elaine-sales: RBAC is important—finance teams should only see cost for their org/team. Also they want to compare actual spending vs committed Dedicated capacity.

maria-pm: Draft acceptance criteria for MVP: 1) Console card with per-team & per-model daily cost for selected date range, 2) CSV export of selected view, 3) API to fetch same data, 4) RBAC respects org/team scopes, 5) Docs + small sample dashboard template.

dan-eng: Technical notes: will implement rollup job that writes to analytics table: columns: date, org_id, team_id, model_name, route, tokens, cost_usd, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms. CSV export can hit the analytics table via an internal API.

olivia-telemetry: For latency heatmap stretch: we can produce a per-route histogram (buckets) and a link to traces for p95 buckets. Might need sampling on traces.

alerts-bot: deploybot: new feature branch created: feature/console-cost-rollup by @dan-eng — CI passing.

maria-pm: Decision: triage to backlog as P2 (enterprise-impact, cross-org). Scope negotiated: ship MVP (per-team/per-model cost + CSV + API + RBAC) first, and schedule heatmap/traces in next cycle if customers confirm. Assign owners: maria-pm (product), dan-eng (eng), olivia-telemetry (telemetry), jamal-support (customer validation).

elaine-sales: I'll surface to ACME and ask for a short acceptance checklist. If they sign off we can prioritize higher. :thumbsup:

jamal-support: I'll open a support tracker linking affected customers and collect sample queries they need.

maria-pm: Thanks—I'll create a GH issue with acceptance criteria and link this thread. If anyone has immediate must-have columns for CSV, drop them here.

elaine-sales: Column request from ACME: team_id, team_name, model_name, route, tokens, cost_usd, committed_capacity_id (if any), date, region.

dan-eng: Noted. We'll include those in schema.

maria-pm: Cool. Moving to backlog. Will update GH issue and roadmap board. :sparkles:
